_doc: PI Copilot process safety policy. deny: never run from PI Copilot. confirmAlways: ask the user before every run, in every mode. confirmWhen: ask when the effective value of `parameter` (as given, else the process default) equals `equals` (or, with `notEquals`, is anything other than that value). reviewedSafe: flagged by the file/disk/window heuristic but reviewed: no effect beyond the target image or new windows. fileTables: path rules for global runs (Task 8).

deny.GraXpert: it launches an external program whose path is a parameter (appPath), which PI Copilot cannot check
deny.IndigoCCDFrame: it controls a camera through an INDIGO server (exposures, uploads, file saving)
deny.IndigoDeviceController: it sends commands to observatory devices through an INDIGO server
deny.IndigoMount: it moves the telescope mount through an INDIGO server
deny.PICopilot: it is PI Copilot itself (running it from the chat would recurse)
deny.Preferences: it changes PixInsight's application settings, including its script-signature security settings
deny.ProcessContainer: it runs a list of other processes that PI Copilot cannot check one by one
deny.Script: it runs a PJSR script file, which PI Copilot cannot review from here (scripts go through run_pjsr, which shows the whole script first)

confirmAlways.APASS: it can write catalog search results to files, and its configure commands change the catalog database settings
confirmAlways.BlurXTerminator: its compiled plug-in can crash PixInsight (SIGABRT) on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs such as the RTX 50 series, losing unsaved work; Script > RC-Astro runs the same tool through its command-line version instead
confirmAlways.ColorManagementSetup: it changes PixInsight's global color-management settings
confirmAlways.CometAlignment: it writes comet-aligned copies of the input frames to its output directory and can overwrite existing files
confirmAlways.CosmeticCorrection: it writes corrected copies of the input frames to its output directory
confirmAlways.Debayer: it writes debayered copies of the input frames to its output directory
confirmAlways.DrizzleIntegration: it reads drizzle data files from disk and can write output files
confirmAlways.EphemerisGenerator: it writes ephemeris (.xeph) and log files to disk
confirmAlways.FastIntegration: it writes registered frames, log and weights files to its output directory
confirmAlways.FilterManager: it reads and writes the filters database file
confirmAlways.Gaia: it can write catalog search results to files, and its configure commands change the catalog database settings
confirmAlways.ImageCalibration: it writes calibrated copies of the input frames to its output directory and can overwrite existing files
confirmAlways.LocalNormalization: it writes normalization data files (.xnml) to disk
confirmAlways.NSGXnml: it writes normalization data files (.xnml) to its output directory
confirmAlways.NoiseXTerminator: its compiled plug-in can crash PixInsight (SIGABRT) on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs such as the RTX 50 series, losing unsaved work; Script > RC-Astro runs the same tool through its command-line version instead
confirmAlways.NukeX: it writes cache files to its cache directory while stacking
confirmAlways.SplitCFA: in the global context it writes split CFA frames to its output directory
confirmAlways.StarAlignment: in the global context it writes registered copies of the input frames to its output directory
confirmAlways.StarXTerminator: its compiled plug-in can crash PixInsight (SIGABRT) on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs such as the RTX 50 series, losing unsaved work; Script > RC-Astro runs the same tool through its command-line version instead
confirmAlways.SubframeSelector: it can copy or move approved and rejected frames to output directories
confirmAlways.SubframeStudio: it writes measurement CSV files and a metrics cache to disk

CreateAlphaChannels.reason: it closes the source image window used for the alpha channel, and unsaved changes there are lost

FindingChart.reason: it writes the finding chart as an image file to its output directory

HDRComposition.reason: it closes the images created by a previous HDRComposition run, and unsaved results are lost

ImageIntegration.reason: it updates the frames' .xdrz drizzle files on disk
it closes the images created by a previous ImageIntegration run, and unsaved results are lost

MultiscaleGradientCorrection.reason: a command runs a MARS database operation instead of a gradient correction

PhotometricColorCalibration.reason: it writes calibration text files to its output directory

SpectrophotometricColorCalibration.reason: it writes calibration text files to its output directory

SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration.reason: it writes calibration text files to its output directory

reviewedSafe.ACDNR: 'maskRemovedWaveletLayers' is a mask option inside the image
reviewedSafe.AssignICCProfile: 'targetProfile' names the ICC profile assigned to the image
reviewedSafe.AstroResolver: 'simbadServer' is the online name-lookup service it queries; it writes no files
reviewedSafe.AutomaticBackgroundExtractor: 'writeSampleBoxes' draws the sample boxes into the model image
reviewedSafe.B3Estimator: its 'output...' options choose which new images it opens
reviewedSafe.ColorCalibration: its 'output...Mask' options open new mask windows
reviewedSafe.ExtractAlphaChannels: 'delete' removes the alpha channels from the target image itself
reviewedSafe.GradientHDRComposition: it reads its input frames and opens a new image; 'dLogBias'/'bKeepLog' are logarithm options
reviewedSafe.GradientMergeMosaic: it reads its input frames and opens a new image
reviewedSafe.ICCProfileTransformation: 'targetProfile' names the ICC profile the image is converted to
reviewedSafe.MLDenoise: 'modelPath' is a model file it reads; 'useCache' keeps loaded models in memory
reviewedSafe.MorphologicalTransformation: 'structureName' is the name of its structuring element (matched only by the 'rename' pattern)
reviewedSafe.PixelMath: its caches are in memory, 'generateOutput' concerns the result image, 'outputData' is an in-memory result table
reviewedSafe.SCNR: 'colorToRemove' chooses the color channel it neutralizes
